statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of five public paths/templates. Not covered: authenticated account areas, payment/subscription completion, destructive account actions, and media playback to completion because they require credentials, external commitments, or prolonged explicit content interaction.

page.framework: server-rendered MPA with client-side enhancement and service worker
page.notes: Arabic RTL public media catalog. Server HTML is substantial (not a JS shell), with desktop/mobile variants and a repeated consent interstitial.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared emulated light/dark screenshots and computed CSS.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark/light captures match and root colorScheme is normal with a hard-coded dark class.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated reduced motion and inspected document.getAnimations().
checkOutcomes.evidence: Eight 2-second infinite animations remain running under reduce.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual inspection under prefers-contrast/forced-colors.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Forced-colors capture retains visible text, controls, borders, and underlined links.

checkOutcomes.method: CSSOM and route/template inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: MPA routes have no authored cross-document transition treatment.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected animations/CSS timelines and scrolled listing.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No parallax, scrollytelling, or scroll-linked animation exists on the representative templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: There is no scroll-linked motion to implement declaratively.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM interaction inventory and CSS/JS behavior inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Primary interactions are native links, buttons, scrolling, and media controls; no custom pointermove/swipe surface was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Desktop/mobile screenshots and navigation DOM inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Persistent header/sidebar and active category state keep location and primary navigation visible during long listings.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected overlays, menus, and transient surfaces.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip or edge-sensitive anchored popover appeared in representative flows.
checkOutcomes.reason: No anchored tooltip/popover surface was present to assess.

checkOutcomes.method: Representative route inspection and transition CSS probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Cross-document category/detail changes lack directional or transition cues.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared initial screenshots across four templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Consent layer covers primary content on all tested entry routes.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM and accessibility semantics probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Blocking consent UI is a plain DIV without dialog/aria-modal semantics.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual hierarchy review at desktop and 360x800.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Navigation/promotional chrome dominates narrow viewport and clips primary cards.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout metrics at 360x800 on two templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both home and detail report 664 px horizontal overflow at 360 px.

checkOutcomes.method: CSSOM @container rule count plus visual reuse inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No container rules were found despite reused components in constrained regions.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic focus/computed style and target geometry probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focused link has no outline and 53 visible targets are below 24 px.

checkOutcomes.method: First-viewport and heading/action inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: H1, descriptive localized metadata, content cards, category links, and signup CTA make purpose and next action clear.

checkOutcomes.method: Walked entry-to-detail and signup action inventory without submitting external/account data.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Consent offers accept/reject, content cards use real detail hrefs, and signup presents Google, X, email, terms, and login paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Requested and visually inspected representative 404.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Unknown URL returns real HTTP 404 and renders localized recovery content plus homepage/content links.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse plus independent DevTools trace.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse LCP is 4.4 s; trace result varies by condition.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout-shift observer on home at two viewports.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Layout observers recorded CLS 0 with no shifts on desktop and mobile during the capture window.

checkOutcomes.method: Trace and long-task observers.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace TBT 145.15 ms and layout captures include tasks up to 157 ms.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against deferred script attributes and Lighthouse.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Four parser styles are VeryHigh; Lighthouse flags render-blocking/cache savings.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR weight analysis and Lighthouse coverage diagnostics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 62 scripts transfer 1.03 MB; Lighthouse reports unused JS/CSS.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audit and DOM probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse identifies an unnamed card button; consent lacks dialog semantics.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse axe contrast rules plus forced-color screenshot.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Measured failures include 1.75:1, 2.15:1, and 3.29:1 text.

checkOutcomes.method: Focus probe, Lighthouse structure audit, heading inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No visible focus outline; list semantics fail; signup begins with H3.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual inspection across default and forced-color screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Arabic body and headings are comfortably sized, RTL-aligned, unclipped on desktop, and remain visible in forced colors.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse mobile audit, layout metrics, media DOM inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse fails viewport/targets; detail overflows and video has no tracks.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse browser diagnostics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices score is 1.0 and its console-error audit passes.

checkOutcomes.method: Document probe plus images primitive.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype/UTF-8 are valid, but 29 images lack dimensions and 13 are oversized.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse diagnostics and DOM interaction inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices is 1.0; no on-load permission prompts, paste prevention, deprecated API, or console issue was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM metadata inspection across three templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home, signup, and detail have localized descriptive titles and meta descriptions.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse SEO, DOM links, robots.txt.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse SEO is 1.0; links are real hrefs, viewport meta exists, and robots permits public routes.

checkOutcomes.method: HTTP/metadata/robots/sitemap inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Canonical/status are sound, but /sitemap.xml is empty and robots has no Sitemap directive.

checkOutcomes.method: Parsed Open Graph and JSON-LD on representative detail.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Detail has Open Graph metadata but no VideoObject JSON-LD.

checkOutcomes.method: Headers and cookie primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS/frame controls exist, but CSP is frame-only and cookies/header flags are incomplete.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR and tracker-origin primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 118 third-party requests transfer 1.63 MB across 15 origins before a core action.

checkOutcomes.method: Signup action and script/API inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No prompt fires on load, but signup has no passkey/WebAuthn path.

checkOutcomes.method: Security headers primitive.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HSTS lifetime is one day; CSP, Referrer-Policy, nosniff and Permissions-Policy coverage are weak.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw-fetch/rendered DOM and crawler screenshot comparison.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw HTML carries essential metadata but only 54% of rendered content tokens.

checkOutcomes.method: Cross-template screenshots/DOM and Lighthouse diagnostics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative home, category, signup, detail, and 404 templates render stable UI without cut-off overlay chrome on desktop or uncaught runtime errors.

checkOutcomes.method: Manifest fetch, service-worker registration probe, and worker static inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A valid manifest is linked and an active service worker is registered; its script contains cache and offline handling paths.

checkOutcomes.method: HTTP 404 capture and service-worker inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A real 404 response renders localized explanation and recovery content; service worker contains offline handling.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM attributes and visual inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Document declares lang=ar and dir=rtl; navigation, text alignment, and mirrored layout render RTL across templates.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered text and locale navigation inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Durations, view counts, labels, and the full account/navigation surface are localized, with explicit links to many locale variants.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered data and controls across representative paths.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No date scheduling, recurring events, time-zone conversion, or absolute event time appears in the audited content/signup flows.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited surfaces do not expose time-zone-sensitive data or scheduling.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual consent/signup review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Consent presents equally prominent accept and reject choices and links privacy policy; no preselected upsell or confirmshaming appeared.

checkOutcomes.method: Form inventory on home/signup.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No required data-entry form or validation state is exposed before the user explicitly chooses email signup; search has no required constraints.
checkOutcomes.reason: No representative required-field validation flow was present without creating an account.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected all rendered form controls and autocomplete attributes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited surface exposes only search (where stored autofill is not required) before account-provider selection; no address/payment/sign-in fields are present.
checkOutcomes.reason: No address, payment, or credential input fields were present in the audited pre-account flow.

checkOutcomes.method: Signup screenshot and action inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Signup clearly labels Google, X, email and existing-login paths, with terms and privacy links visible; no hidden pricing/continuity appeared.

checkOutcomes.method: Images primitive and HAR resource inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 13 images are oversized, 15 use legacy formats, and 8 below-fold images are not lazy.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR and trace review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 145 requests/62 scripts and startup long tasks occur before content selection.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR origin/byte analysis and tracker inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 118 third-party requests account for 1.63 MB of a 1.82 MB load.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon of site purpose, forms, metadata, and scripts.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No transaction/productivity tool surface needs agent actions; this is a public media catalog.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited site exposes content discovery/playback rather than an agent-operable productivity or commerce capability.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon and script/API inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarization, generation, or local inference task is part of the representative journeys.
checkOutcomes.reason: There is no user task in the audited flows for which on-device inference is applicable.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline/post heap snapshots around repeated listing scroll interaction.
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten repeated full-list scroll cycles, heap self size decreased from 36,867,093 to 36,769,729 bytes; node count changed only +242 (0.04%).

checkOutcomes.method: Heap totals and Performance.memory/DOM metrics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Single-state heap is 36.9 MB with 684,036 nodes in the snapshot graph; runtime DOM is 1,799 elements and used JS heap is 22.6 MB, proportionate to a media listing.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared baseline/post heap graph totals after ten interactions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Repeated interaction did not produce material node/edge growth: +242 nodes and +1,124 edges with lower self size. No unbounded accumulation signal appeared.

principleOutcomes.reason: All checks were judged not applicable for the audited site and paths.

paths.description: Public home and primary content-listing template; tested consent state, metadata, responsiveness, preferences, performance, privacy, accessibility, and core navigation.
Representative category/listing template for filtering and repeated content-card behavior.
Representative media-detail and playback template, selected from a rendered home-page link.
Primary account-creation journey, including social/email entry points, terms, and consent interruption.
Representative HTTP failure/recovery route; confirms a real 404 response and recovery content.

findings.summary: The interface imposes one dark palette instead of following the user color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark and light emulation screenshots are materially identical; the UI probe reports computed colorScheme "normal" while the root is hard-coded with class "dark".
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and derive surfaces/controls from prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), while retaining an explicit user override.

findings.summary: Animations continue when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the evaluate probe found eight running animations, each with 2000 ms duration and unbounded iterations.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential animation and auto-advance in a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce query, preserving only state communication.

findings.summary: Cross-document navigation changes state abruptly and does not guide attention.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS probes found no authored transition treatment for the many MPA category/detail routes; only the browser root view-transition name exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } for same-origin MPA routes and directional names only where motion improves orientation, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: A consent interstitial obscures the primary content on every tested entry route.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots of home, category, signup, and 404 show the same large centered consent layer covering the page before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the legally required choice concise and content-aware; avoid re-presenting it across routes once a decision is stored and ensure users can continue immediately with either choice.

findings.summary: The blocking consent surface is an unlabelled custom div rather than a semantic modal.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found no dialog, role=dialog, or aria-modal; the accept button parent is a plain DIV and focus is not programmatically contained.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a modal <dialog> with an accessible name, initial focus, Escape/cancel policy appropriate to consent, and focus restoration.

findings.summary: Navigation and promotional chrome crowd the content, especially in the narrow view.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 screenshot is dominated by a full-height navigation rail while primary cards are clipped to a narrow strip; 53 undersized interactive targets add visual density.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary navigation into a mobile disclosure, reduce duplicate sidebars/promotions, and reserve the first viewport for the primary content task.

findings.summary: The site serves a 1024 px desktop canvas into a 360 px viewport.
findings.evidence: Layout reported scrollWidth 1024, client/visual width 360, and 664 px horizontal overflow on both the home and detail templates; the screenshot visibly clips most content.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove platform-forced desktop sizing, keep layout width at 100%, use intrinsic grid sizing/minmax(), and verify all representative templates at 360 CSS px.

findings.summary: Reusable card and navigation components do not adapt to their available container.
findings.evidence: The CSSOM probe found zero container rules, while the same content-card/navigation system is reused in constrained sidebars and the clipped mobile layout.
findings.suggestedFix: Establish containment on reusable regions and use @container rules for card density, labels, and sidebar-to-drawer changes, with viewport fallbacks where needed.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch target support are inadequate.
findings.evidence: Focusing the first actionable link produced outline-style none, and the active probe counted 53 visible controls smaller than 24 px; Lighthouse also failed target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator and enlarge/space controls to at least the WCAG target-size floor, preferably 44 CSS px for primary touch actions.

findings.summary: Lab loading performance misses the good LCP range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.4 s (performance 0.79); the independent trace observed 1.45 s LCP in a warmer desktop condition, so the mobile throttled result is the risk signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the mobile LCP element, prioritise only that resource, shorten render-blocking chains, and defer non-critical scripts and below-fold cards.

findings.summary: Startup JavaScript creates user-visible main-thread blocking.
findings.evidence: The trace recorded two long tasks, longest 148.47 ms, with 145.15 ms total blocking time; mobile layout observation also recorded 95 ms and 157 ms tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Split initialization at task boundaries, schedule non-critical work after paint/idle, and load route-specific code on demand.

findings.summary: The critical path contains excessive parser-inserted styles and weak cache opportunities.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 13 stylesheets and flagged four VeryHigh parser-inserted styles; Lighthouse estimated 1,100 ms render-blocking savings and 115 KiB cache-lifetime savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only minimal critical styles, consolidate/defer route CSS, and set durable immutable caching for hashed static assets.

findings.summary: The page ships a large script surface with measurable unused code.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 62 scripts and 1,029,114 transferred script bytes; the largest bundle is 400,245 bytes. Lighthouse estimates 26 KiB unused JS and 56 KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Use coverage to remove dead code, split locale/route features, and gate third-party/account code until the user invokes it.

findings.summary: Some controls have no accessible name.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.75 and identified an unnamed 40x24 button in the content-card list; the custom consent surface also lacks dialog semantics.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every icon button a stable accessible name, preserve correct native roles, and test the accessibility tree after dynamic rendering.

findings.summary: Important text does not meet WCAG contrast minimums.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 2.15:1 and 1.75:1 text on the age-verification banner plus repeated metadata at 3.29:1 on #202020.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise foreground/background contrast to at least 4.5:1 for normal text and verify all normal, hover, disabled, and forced-color states.

findings.summary: Focus treatment and list semantics are not robust.
findings.evidence: The focus probe showed no visible outline on the first link, Lighthouse failed list semantics, and the signup page starts at H3 without an H1/H2 hierarchy.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore visible focus, use valid ul/ol > li structure, and give each template one logical H1 followed by ordered headings.

findings.summary: Mobile scaling, reflow, target sizes, and media alternatives are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and target-size checks in its mobile run; the detail page overflows by 664 px and its video element exposes no caption tracks.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user zoom, fix true mobile reflow, enlarge targets, and provide synchronized captions or equivalent transcripts for spoken media.

findings.summary: Image markup and delivery are inefficient.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 29/36 images without explicit dimensions, 13 oversized images, 15 legacy-format responses, and 8 below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio, select responsive sources close to rendered size, prefer modern encodings, and lazy-load only below-fold images.

findings.summary: The large public catalog does not expose a discoverable sitemap from the audited host.
findings.evidence: robots.txt is detailed but contains no Sitemap directive, and GET /sitemap.xml returned an empty body; canonical URLs and HTTP statuses otherwise worked.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish sitemap indexes for stable public catalog URLs and reference them from robots.txt; keep excluded/private routes out.

findings.summary: The media-detail template lacks structured video metadata.
findings.evidence: The detail page has Open Graph fields but no JSON-LD block, even though it represents a video entity with title, thumbnail, creator/category, and duration data.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD that matches visible content, including thumbnailUrl, uploadDate, duration, and contentUrl/embedUrl as policy allows.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but CSP and cookie protections are incomplete.
findings.evidence: CSP contains only frame-ancestors; X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy are absent. Three of four observed cookies were flagged insecure, including a year-long settings cookie without Secure and with SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an enforcing script/style CSP, add nosniff and a restrictive referrer policy, and set Secure plus an appropriate SameSite value on every HTTPS cookie.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are too narrow for a script-heavy site.
findings.evidence: HSTS is only max-age=86400 despite preload text, CSP has no script/style/default-src directives, Referrer-Policy is absent, and Permissions-Policy only discusses two client hints.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a long-lived preload-eligible HSTS policy, nonce/hash-based CSP (and Trusted Types where viable), explicit Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The default page load has a large third-party and tracking-shaped footprint.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 118 third-party requests and 1,626,910 third-party bytes across 15 origins, including Google account code, advertising/CDN origins, and collector/recoil endpoints before a core content action.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay optional identity, advertising, analytics, and recommendation code until consent/context requires it; minimise identifiers and batch essential analytics.

findings.summary: Account creation offers federated and email paths but no phishing-resistant passkey path.
findings.evidence: The signup action inventory exposes Google, X, and email registration; DOM/script probes found no WebAuthn/passkey registration or authentication affordance. No permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration and authentication alongside existing recovery-capable methods, offered in context after account intent.

findings.summary: A substantial share of rendered content is absent without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability comparison found only 54% raw/rendered token coverage. The server HTML keeps title, H1, and description, but nearly half of rendered content is client-dependent.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render stable listing/detail content and real links, then hydrate enhancements; preserve functional search/navigation and consent choices without scripting.

findings.summary: Default loading performs disproportionate background and third-party work.
findings.evidence: The home load makes 145 requests, including 62 scripts and 118 third-party requests, before the user chooses content; the trace records two startup long tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate optional features behind interaction/consent, deprioritize background fetches, and remove route-irrelevant initialization.
